items.title: Deep diamond drilling confirms substantial vertical extent at Cangallo
items.summary: CANDD003 reached about 880 m; copper mineralization was logged from near surface to about 550 m depth, transitioning from oxides to hypogene sulphides.

items.title: Cangallo positioned for further RC and diamond drilling in 2026
items.summary: AusQuest described a mineralized corridor over 1.5 km strike, 250–500 m wide and over 400 m deep, with further 2026 drilling planned.

items.title: Kilometre-scale mineralized intervals extend Pecoy below the resource pit shell
items.summary: Two South Breccia holes returned kilometre-scale mineralized intervals, including PEC-25-065 and PEC-25-066, reinforcing scale and depth continuity.

items.title: Pecoy launches fully funded district-scale 2026 exploration program
items.summary: Up to 40,000 m of drilling was planned across five Pecoy target areas plus about 5,000 m at Tororume.

items.title: Panoro signs cooperation agreement with Municipality of Cotabambas
items.summary: A new local cooperation agreement accompanies the expanding 2026 exploration program at Cotabambas.

items.title: South Pit drilling continues to intersect high-grade mineralization
items.summary: CB-229 and CB-230 tested southeast and depth extensions of the high-grade South Pit porphyry mineralization, with Panoro reporting potential for resource growth.

items.title: Panoro reports 317.6 m at 1.04% CuEq at Cotabambas
items.summary: Material high-grade drilling result from the 2026 program.

items.title: 2026 Cotabambas drill program mobilized and started
items.summary: Panoro commenced the funded 2026 drilling campaign following its high-grade development strategy.

items.title: Panoro announces funded 2026 drilling program
items.summary: The company set out the funded 2026 drilling campaign for Cotabambas.

items.title: DIA approved for drilling at Pucamayo Sur
items.summary: MINEM approved a five-year DIA covering 40 drill pads; Condor planned a phased program of up to 6,000 m.

items.title: Aftermath provides Berenguela project update
items.summary: Ongoing work continued alongside the PFS-stage advancement of the Berenguela Ag-Cu-Mn project.

items.title: Drilling begins at Berenguela eastern copper target
items.summary: Aftermath started drilling a new eastern copper target at Berenguela.

items.title: Berenguela returns 30.0 m of 77 g/t Ag and 2.93% Cu
items.summary: High-grade copper-silver drilling result from the 2026 campaign.

items.title: Berenguela returns 33.2 m at 394 g/t Ag and 1.19% Cu
items.summary: Another material high-grade Ag-Cu intercept from the 2026 drilling campaign.

items.title: Berenguela reports multiple high-grade Ag-Cu intercepts
items.summary: Results included a reported 48.5 m interval at 438 g/t Ag and 2.22% Cu.

items.title: Berenguela pre-feasibility study launched
items.summary: Aftermath formally moved Berenguela into PFS-stage evaluation.

items.title: Aftermath completes acquisition of Berenguela
items.summary: The company completed acquisition of the Berenguela silver-copper-manganese project in Peru.

items.title: Nueva Recuperada resource expands materially
items.summary: Silver X reported 10.4 Mt M&I at 213 g/t AgEq and 21.6 Mt inferred at 252 g/t AgEq; a 40,000 m drill program was underway across the district.

items.title: Palamina completes Colt Silver spin-out and refocuses on gold
items.summary: Palamina completed the Colt Silver spin-out while continuing to advance its 100%-owned Usicayos gold project.

items.title: Usicayos drilling remains planned subject to surface access
items.summary: Further SDO drilling and inaugural Cayos drilling were planned for 2026, with Cayos dependent on securing surface-rights agreements.
